dataset_family: Retrospective chart review, Pacific Brain Health Center, Santa Monica CA (2018-2021; 161 patients with qEEG/ERP, of whom 111 also had volumetric MRI; SCD/MCI/dementia, no healthy controls). New and not shared with any current supporter or other candidate.
method_family: Task-evoked EEG/ERP from a Go/No-Go oddball task (eVox; P300b amplitude) together with behavioural task measures (reaction time, commission errors), compared with and combined with automated volumetric MRI (Neuroreader, ICV-normalised regional volumes). Electrophysiology may count as the same broad family as supporter P-584's MEG, although P-584 used resting spectral alpha power rather than a task ERP.
what_it_shows: For MCI vs SCD, the qEEG/ERP-only model (AUC 0.72, 95% CI 0.63-0.82) and the left-temporal-lobe-volume model (AUC 0.74, 0.63-0.85) performed about equally, and the combination gave 0.79. In the three-class model, P300b amplitude and commission errors stayed significant alongside left temporal lobe volume. Left temporal lobe volume itself differed significantly between MCI and SCD (p < 0.0004). In the imaging subset, P300b amplitude did not separate MCI from SCD post hoc (only dementia < SCD).
why: Stated form: NO. Volume was discriminative, not preserved. Left temporal lobe volume separated MCI from SCD (91.4 vs 99.1, p < 0.0004, Table 2, p.5), and the volume model matched or exceeded the qEEG/ERP model for MCI vs SCD (0.74 vs 0.72, Table 3, p.6). Nothing shows detection where volume is preserved, and there is no conversion outcome. Narrowed form: PARTLY, and weak. The paper shows (1) parity: 'AUCs that are very similar to those using only qEEG/ERP measures' (p.5), and (2) complementarity: P300b amplitude (OR 0.25, p = 0.008) was retained alongside left temporal volume, and the combined model was 'superior to either of the two alone in all cases' (p.6). Limits: (a) The comparator is SCD, not healthy controls; the authors note there is no control group (p.7). (b) The volume retained is left temporal lobe, not hippocampal. Hippocampal volumes were candidates (p.4) but were not retained, and the paper does not report hippocampal volume group differences. (c) The 'qEEG/ERP' model's MCI signal includes behavioural task measures. In the n = 111 imaging subset, only commission errors separated MCI from SCD (p < 0.04), while P300b did not (only dementia < SCD, p < 0.02). The non-volumetric information for MCI specifically is therefore largely cognitive task performance, not an electrophysiological measure. (d) The complementarity is shown in a three-class multinomial model dominated by dementia contrasts. (e) There is no between-AUC test, and stepwise selection on the full data preceded leave-one-out CV. (f) One co-author is affiliated with Evoke Neuroscience, the device maker. Independence: new dataset. Electrophysiology may overlap P-584's MEG family. No shared authors or site with supporters. Peer-reviewed (J Alzheimers Dis 2022).

Amongst all the regional volumes tested for model inclusion, using only the left temporal lobe (normalized by intracranial volume) was sufficient to differentiate cognitive diagnostic category with an accuracy of 0.77. Left temporal lobe volume differed significantly between all 3 groups (Table 2). Pairwise differentiation of cognitive categories using this volume measure yielded AUCs that are very similar to those using only qEEG/ERP measures (Table 3).

While P300b amplitude and Commission Errors as well as left temporal lobe volume remained significant predictors, Reaction Time was no longer associated with cognitive category in the combined model. Examining the pairwise AUCs, the predictive performance of this combined qEEG/ERP and vMRI model was superior to either of the two alone in all cases (Table 3; Supplementary Figure).
Amongst the volumes provided by Neuroreader, we used left and right hippocampal, amygdala, temporal lobe, frontal lobe, and lateral ventricle volumes in our analyses
The qEEG assessment consisted of a 5-min "Eyes Open" resting-state condition, a 5-min "Eyes Closed" resting-state condition, and a 15-min Go-No Go button-press task to generate ERP data.

As this study utilized a convenience sample of the patients who presented to Pacific Brain Health Center (PBHC) in Santa Monica, CA with memory and/or other cognitive complaints, it does not include a healthy control group
